driveSpeed.note: 20245 on 25 Oct 2026 (no turret, launchers, transfer or extractor; Foresight tuned 17 Oct; 11.95 V at the end): R-Quals' 106.6 in straight S_CATCH to FAR_FLOWER_TURN took 2.14 s on two runs (13.65-15.79 s in the 19:53 log) where the preview's trapezoid at the drawing's 50 in/s and 45 in/s^2 takes 3.24 s, so 1.5x; R-Simple's 95 in curve START to PARK arrived in 2.5 s against 3.0 s, so 1.2x on a curve. From /Odometry/PedroInches (about 43 Hz), 300 ms centred windows: peak 76 to 78 in/s on the straight (Foresight measured 77 on 17 Oct), about 63 to 71 in/s^2 from rest, 48 to 76 in/s^2 braking; the curve peaked at 56 to 57 in/s (part strafe, 43 in/s max), about 30 up, 100 to 120 down. An earlier 100 ms-window reading (93 / 100 / 60) was noise. The value itself is from the card durations, not the peaks. The Visualizer scales every path by one factor, so 1.5 fits the straights and over-states the curves. Expect a re-measurement once the full mass goes on: doc/real-vs-sim-25-oct.md
